explication: SET is an interactive framework for authorized social-engineering assessments. The README documents its console entry point; the tree shows web, phishing, payload, listener, wireless, and FastTrack capabilities. Sampled source confirms several local behaviors—such as HTTP form capture, SMTP delivery, third-party module dispatch, and server/listener startup—but does not expose the complete console routing, so unsupported wiring is left out.
